entities.name: Johann Nepomuk von Tschiderer zu Gleifheim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Nepomuk von Tschiderer zu Gleifheim was an Austrian-Italian Roman Catholic prelate and the Bishop of Trent from 1834 until his death. He was born to Austrians but was considered to be an Austro-Italian due to having been born in the Italian town of Bolzano.
